ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Health Sciences Information Services and Resources] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students (including Bioinformatics majors) may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu). Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.continuinged.illinois.edu/outreach/. Required on-campus session Thursday, March 4. See section description for 530B at http://lis.illinois.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html
